rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + zip. However, the agent performed two order-changing writes without first obtaining explicit confirmation: (1) it updated the shipping address on pending order #W6729841 immediately after the user indicated which past order to copy, without restating the exact change and seeking approval; (2) it executed the exchange of the delivered air purifier on order #W3445693 without confirming the exact replacement and any potential charge before proceeding. The watch modification on #W4219264 did include an explicit confirmation and appears consistent with tool outputs. Final information given after each change was reasonable and supported by tools, but the missing confirmations before two writes violates policy, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
